{{Quote|Hunt the Jedi. Get others to hunt them as well. Offer bounties. Ten times more for one alive than dead. One might be turned.|[[Darth Krayt]]|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
The '''Third Jedi Purge''' was an attempt to eradicate the [[New Jedi Order]] instigated by [[Darth Krayt]] and his heretical [[One Sith]] in order to impose the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] will on the galaxy. Preceded by heavy casualties in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|Battle of Coruscant]], in the initial attack, only half of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] died at Coruscant and at the [[Massacre at Ossus]].

The remaining Jedi went into hiding, many taking shelter in the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], while others left the Jedi way. The new Emperor feared the Jedi would join the deposed [[Roan Fel]] and his [[Empire-in-exile]], or the Galactic Alliance Remnant and ordered [[Darth Maladi]], head of [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]] to offer bounties in exchange for the capture of Jedi.

To a lesser extent, [[Imperial Knight]]s were also targets of this persecution because of their loyalty to the deposed Emperor and their unorthodox take on Jedi teachings. After the death of [[Darth Krayt]] in 138 ABY the Purge was brought to an end.

Despite the One Sith advantages, as with the [[First Jedi Purge|previous]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purges]], the opposite result they were hoping for happened, the Jedi rallied as many members of their order retreated to their hidden temple, and many later participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|war's final battle]]. During the battle, [[Cade Skywalker]] struck down [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt and the One Sith lost much of their military power and retreated, leaving the allies victorious and the Jedi free to rebuild their order.

==Casualties==
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]]: Killed by [[Darth Nihl]] during the [[Massacre at Ossus]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
*Imperial Knight [[Mohrgan Fel]]: Killed by Darth Krayt.<ref name="Legacy 1" />
*A [[Unidentified short-haired Imperial Knight|short-haired Imperial Knight]]: Killed by Darth Krayt<ref name="Legacy 1" />
*[[Unidentified Imperial Knight 1|An Imperial Knight]]: Killed by Darth Krayt<ref name="Legacy 1" />
*[[Unidentified Imperial Knight 2|Another Imperial Knight]]: Killed by Darth Krayt<ref name="Legacy 1" />
*Jedi Master [[Ahn Rasi Tuum]]: Killed by the One Sith.<ref name="Legacy 2" />
*[[Elke Vetter]]: Killed by [[Darth Talon]]<ref name="Legacy 2" />
*A Human Jedi: Killed by an [[Unidentified Human Sith (Daluuj)|Unidentified Sith Lord]].<ref name="Legacy 2" />
*Jedi Master [[Hira]]: [[Unidentified Nautolan Sith (Agamar)|unidentified]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Legacy 44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]/[[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Hosk Trey'lis]]: Killed by Darth Krayt.<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>
*[[Unidentified female Imperial Knight (Agamar corpse)|Unidentified female Imperial Knight]]: Killed on [[Agamar]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />
*[[Unidentified male Imperial Knight (Agamar corpse)|Unidentified male Imperial Knight]]: Killed on [[Agamar]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />
*Jedi Master [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]]: Killed on Taivas.<ref name="War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref>
*Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]]: Killed on Taivas.<ref name="War 4" />
*[[Te Corso]]: Killed on Taivas.<ref name="War 4" />
*Jedi Master [[Drok]]: Killed on Taivas.<ref name="War 4" />
*Jedi Healer [[Sayar Dun'La]]: Killed on Taivas.<ref name="War 4" />
*Jedi Master [[Wolf Sazen]]: Killed by [[Darth Stryfe]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="War 5" />
*Jedi Knight [[Cade Skywalker]]: Killed by Darth Krayt (then immediately [[Dark transfer|resurrected]] by Darth Krayt)<ref name="War 6" />
*[[Roan Fel]]: Killed by [[Antares Draco]] after the Emperor fell to the dark side due to Sith manipulations.<ref name="War 6" />

==Known survivors==
Several Jedi or former Jedi eluded capture or death during the Purge and survived, though several were killed after its conclusion.
*Jedi Master [[Shado Vao]]: Survived the Jedi Purge<ref name="Legacy 2" />
*Padawan [[Cade Skywalker]]: Survived the Jedi Purge and became a pirate,<ref name="Legacy 2" /> until his death and resurrection.<ref name="War 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The third Jedi Purge was mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]] a pre-release supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' comic series.<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> It later made its first appearance in [[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
